description: This file contains shell functions for updating boot configuration on embedded devices and performing system upgrades, specifically tailored for Sony devices with emmc partitions in a OpenWrt environment.

methods.name: update_bootconfig
methods.description: Updates the boot configuration partition at a specific offset with a given index, handling multiple partition variants.

methods.name: sony_emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process on Sony devices with eMMC storage, flashing kernel and root filesystem, formatting data partition, and restoring backups.
